IS 1168 : 2020 Cube Sugar-Specification
ICS 67.180.10
FAD 02
Revised Standard from Last Update.
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of test for cube sugar manufactured from refined sugar.
2 REFERENCES
The standards referred in the text contain provisions which through reference in this text constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
